{{Quote|I came out of retirement to help Alderaan. I'll have you know I was quite the spy back in my day.|Maelrich Alde speaks of her past|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Maelrich Alde''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and a member of the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[House Alde]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A noble woman of the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[House Alde]], Maelrich Alde resided on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and her nephew [[Alethios]] served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] at [[Wardpost Landa]]. An opponent to [[House Rist]], Alde sought to disable the Rists' satellite relays in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] and end their ability to monitor communications in the region.<ref name="TOR" />
